item.title: CoD2 Tools for 3ds Max - a modern pipeline for Call of Duty 2 modding
item.description: CoD2 Tools is a work-in-progress plugin that brings the whole Call of Duty 2 modding workflow into 3ds Max 2025+. It imports and exports models, weapons and animations straight from the game files and retargets FBX/mocap animation. It also works as a mini Radiant for editing, compiling and testing maps, and includes an experimental converter for Call of Duty 1 / United Offensive maps.
